g.text: Browser login uses Entra ID. Neither edge skips the gate.
2. No session: redirect to Entra ID
KEY: blue AWS | green service | brown data | red identity | gray external | solid core | dashed option
Steps 1-8 match docs/entra.md. Step 4 sends the client secret and PKCE verifier; Entra returns the ID token.
Step 5 checks signature, tenant issuer, client id, nonce and expiry. Step 6 requires the allowed group.
Step 7 sets the Secure, HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the page. Step 8 checks each later session on knowledge.
Pangolin replaces Caddy only. Its ok resource has no second Pangolin login.
Frames group related parts. Dashed component boxes mark options; all other component boxes mark the core.
